acceptance: The server keeps only SHA-256(secret) in memory, never the plain secret, and never logs it
evidence: rooms.test.ts 'create stores only the secret hash and makes the creator host' and 'secretMatches compares SHA-256 hashes'; security.test.ts secret_never_logged. server 84/84 (unit-workspaces-attempt1.log EXIT=0).

acceptance: In end-to-end tests with 1 host + 2 guests on the fixture page, a play, a pause and a seek issued on any allowed client is applied on every other client (paused flag matches, position within 2.0 s)

Coverage gap carried from T15: a guest-issued action is exercised with 1 guest only.

acceptance: A guest joining 30 s into playback starts within 2.0 s of the host's position after a 3 s settle window
evidence: tolerance_late_join passed: max |diff| 0.215 s over 41 samples (sync-e2e/sync-report.json); engine.test.ts aligns_late_joiner_within_2s (extension 101/101).

acceptance: Programmatic play/pause/seek performed by the sync engine never produce an outgoing `control` message (echo suppression), proven by unit test and by the e2e control-message count
evidence: engine.test.ts suppresses_echo_of_programmatic_seek (extension 101/101); e2e_no_control_echo passed (server control count delta equals user actions; test-e2e-attempt1.log).

acceptance: With simulated one-way latency of 150 ms +/- 50 ms jitter per direction, max |host - guest| <= 2.0 s in every sample (250 ms interval, 10 s window) taken after a 3 s settle window following play, pause, seek, late join and a 3 s simulated buffering stall
evidence: sync-tolerance 6/6 passed in both test:e2e and workspaces runs. test:e2e max |diff|: play 0.276, pause 0.054, seek 0.198, late join 0.215, guest buffering 0.264, host buffering 0.424 s; 41 samples each (artifacts/T17/sync-e2e/sync-report.json). Fixture page plus simulated delay only.

acceptance: A 5-minute sustained playback run sampled every 1 s never exceeds 2.0 s after the initial settle window
evidence: sustained_5_minutes passed in both runs (5.1 m each); test:e2e run max |diff| 0.300 s over 301 samples (sync-e2e/sync-report.json).

acceptance: Guests re-align by seek when |drift| > 1.0 s; drift <= 1.0 s produces no seek
evidence: engine.test.ts ignores_drift_under_threshold and realigns_drift_over_threshold (extension 101/101). Unit evidence only.

acceptance: A guest's own buffering does not count as drift; when buffering ends the guest seeks once to the room's expected position. While the host reports buffering, guests pause and resume when the host resumes
evidence: engine.test.ts buffering_triggers_resync_not_drift and host_buffering_pauses_guests (extension 101/101); e2e tolerance_after_guest_buffering (max 0.264 s) and tolerance_after_host_buffering (max 0.424 s) passed.
